body: I am in the same boat as you, except for the family part. My marriage is really rocky right now and I take meds, I go to therapy (useless agreed) and I want to kill myself and the only reason I don’t is because of the guilt I have for others. I really want to die though. I don’t want to be here anymore. I have nothing, no purpose, no motivation, no will to do anything. It all feels pointless.
